title: Amount fields migrated from integer cents to decimal dollars

changes.description: The `amount` parameter on charge creation now expects a decimal dollar amount (e.g. 10.50) instead of integer cents (1050).

fix.explain: Divide the amount by 100 to convert cents to dollars.

changes.description: The `amount` property on Charge objects is now a decimal string rather than an integer.

fix.explain: Charge.amount is now a decimal string; convert before arithmetic.
